list: The official 55 trophies (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden). Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, cross-checked against PSNProfiles, Exophase and TrueTrophies. Guides are this guide's own words; each cites its sources.

planetgta6.name: Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies (visible / hidden split)

trackers.name: PSNProfiles, Exophase and TrueTrophies — GTA VI trophy list (names, grades, hidden flags)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. It needs no multiplayer and no DLC — the whole list is single-player and offline. Expect roughly 200 hours: 60–80 for the five story chapters, about 100 for the 100% checklist, and around 10 for Strangers & Freaks and cleanup. Keep cheats off the whole run: turning one on disables trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy, impossible to miss. It unlocks when you finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, which opens Chapter 1. Just play the opening mission through to its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops when Chapter 1 ends, right as the first mission of Chapter 2 (What's in the Bag?) begins. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing that might not come back: the balcony meditation at Jason's house — see Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks when Chapter 2 ends, as the first mission of Chapter 3 (Welcome to Vice City) starts. Chapter 2 is also where you first switch freely between Jason and Lucia after the Coffee Break mission — from here, partner trophies and the duo free-roam open up.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life) are done, closing Chapter 3. During Chapter 3 you unlock the Key Cloner, jewelry store robberies and several side questlines — take the optional missions as they appear, since some disappear after a while.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. It unlocks when you finish the final main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. The same mission also ends the story's last chapter stretch, so the final-mission gold follows soon after.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy and the only gold in the story set. It pops when the final main mission is complete — the same mission that closes Chapter 4. Before the credits roll, make a manual save: there is no mission replay and no New Game+, so a save at the end of each chapter is your only safety net.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 main mission; finish it and the trophy pops. No side objective or rating is needed — the game has no mission gold medals this time.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 main mission; complete it and the trophy is yours. It cannot be missed — story missions stay available until you play them.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Child's Play is a Chapter 4 main mission; finishing it pops the trophy. Like every story trophy, it unlocks just by playing the mission to its end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Headliners is a Chapter 4 main mission; complete it and the trophy unlocks. There is nothing extra to do — no hidden objective, no time limit.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 main mission set around Vice City International Airport; finish the mission and the trophy pops. The airport itself matters again later for the Catch Me If You Can trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 main mission; completing it pops the trophy. It is the last of the mission-named story trophies before the finale.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list and the whole second stage of the roadmap — about 100 hours after the story. The checklist only appears after the credits, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but everything you did during the story already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It is far kinder than true 100%: roughly 60% of the game. You need any 100 optional missions, all robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 cocaine flamingos, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 50 of 66 weapons, 10 of 13 race challenge gold medals and 42 of 42 shooting range gold medals. The only parts that demand everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's 15 target decks. Do the optional missions, vehicle scans and animal studies as you play the story — they save hours of cleanup.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts, mixing the four types however you like: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to farm. Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where every stunt keeps its name and stays marked after you finish it. Note the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your progress under Touchpad > Progress > Activities — scrolling over a type shows how many you have done. Most come up naturally in the story and while working on other trophies, so this usually pops on its own.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. Every challenge needs gold — there is no partial credit — but the medals are not considered hard, and the 100% checklist demands all 42 too, so this is not skippable work. Practising at the ranges also raises your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total across them. You need a win at every location, not every race. The 100% checklist also wants all 42 drone time trials finished, so keep racing after the trophy pops. Drone races count toward the racing activity type for Master of None as well.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations. Each race only counts the first time you win it, so you need 20 distinct wins, not 20 wins total. The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 unique races won plus 10 of 13 race challenge gold medals, so you will pass 20 on the way there.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's fishing questline. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his quests and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing itself is also one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. You only need to reach the end — beating every challenge inside is not required. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, using the controllers; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines out in the world. Pick whichever game you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest optional storyline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. The quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All of them stay available after the story, so nothing here can be missed.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams where you work for him; he calls, then shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map — dive for the treasures (a metal detector helps dig them from the ocean floor) and bring them back. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2–3 — playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds his return text. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest optional storyline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. The quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All of them stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands — but only certain questlines count. The game does not count the big optional questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others) as strangers for this trophy. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts: Skunk Apeology 101, Search for Tree Effigies, Advanced Skunk Apeonomics), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, collecting chemicals, checking on Kyle), Yago (street race, mentoring, racing and backing him up) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile quests and his deliveries). More strangers are still being found — the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count. Strangers are not part of the 100% checklist, so save this for the cleanup stage after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List questline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City): Zorrusso, Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on his list, then drive it back — a car delivered in good condition pays more. Cars he marks appear in fixed spots, often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach; finishing a marked one makes him mark the next. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, which is only available as Jason. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Go to the labs and destroy them (the quest Take Out Kitty Litter), and after enough labs are destroyed Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down — completing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The only trophy any guide flags as possibly missable. The first meditation — Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house — is only offered during Chapter 1 and is gone after that chapter. Do it before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at a spot, which counts as +2 at the same location, and you cannot finish the last one until both characters can play together (after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break). Track spots under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you can follow her, choose Accept, and learn to meditate. That balcony session raises your counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, so it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — do it anyway, before Chapter 1 ends, because it never comes back. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so this trophy is stricter than the checklist.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Do Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is exclusive to Jason. It is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that starts Veteran Hunted, meeting him in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation). One clean shot leaves an animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. Track his requests under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 target decks in total, and the 100% checklist wants all 15, so this trophy comes naturally on the way. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets scattered across Leonida. You do not need all 18 — three finished sets pop the trophy. Cards are a pure collectible hunt: check your collection progress in the Progress menu and work through set locations one set at a time rather than grabbing cards at random.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app: hold up on the D-pad, then R1 while looking at a scannable object. There are well over 100 in the world, so any 100 count — the categories are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan things as you pass them during the story and this finishes itself; the 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. They come in 8 categories of 10 each, and you only need 50 here — the 100% checklist later wants 70, so this pops on the way. View and track them under Progress > Challenges; scrolling over one shows a Completed checkmark. Many complete naturally while you work on other trophies, so leave this for late and then pick the easiest remaining ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together — call your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing chaos, then escape: a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works well, and if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down. The easiest reliable escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops when you drive out of the red heat zone, not when you leave the flashing search area. It also tends to pop on its own during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since the large bank vault robberies it unlocks always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between shops. You need the duo free-roam from the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, and your partner is called with right on the D-pad plus Triangle. Hit robbery targets marked with green icons, keep the red/blue flashing wanted level (not the red heat level), and loot each shop properly — go into the back room and break the safe with sticky bombs if you can. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, which open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles out of the 557 in the game (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). Use the WAiNK app — hold up on the D-pad to open it instantly — then look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough; you never need to drive it. The fastest method is to stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. You need 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned for the 100% checklist, so this pops long before that is done.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Kill or incapacitate 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. First, raise your focus: eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch the slow time. Then line up 5 enemies — the criminals at gang operations are ideal — and drop them quickly without missing. An assault rifle like the Duke 556 works better than pistols or SMGs, and body armor from Ammu-Nation lets you step out of cover to get close. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus, the purple eye icon); it rises through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game and often pops naturally at Focus level 4.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport — it must be connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and next to the boarding bridge there are stairs with a door straight into it. Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the pop is delayed until you are that far out. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) and use it. The tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies, marked with a green icon on unfogged map areas. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun (the gadget stays in your inventory; at a locked door you get the choice to kick it, which triggers the alarm, or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach). Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and teaches the method: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, watch the guard carry a briefcase of cash in, then slip in while the vault is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone — bring your partner and hold right on the D-pad to hand off a bag. After that mission, pay Yasmani (the fence from Chapter 3) for security-van tips — $10,000 each, after his earlier payday-loan quests — and vans are marked with a purple icon. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so this pops on the way, and each vault pays up to $205,000 — the best endgame money in the game.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius. The automatic way is the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is — the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies: robbing a large bank's vault counts as robbing an armored truck. For an earlier method, find armored trucks driving around Vice City near banks, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani becomes your fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible. A plane also lets you cover the offshore islands and the far corners of the state without fighting through terrain. This pairs naturally with scanning vehicles and studying animals from the air.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. For this trophy one per gang is enough, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it pops on the way. Track each gang under Progress > Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows, bottom right, how many of its operations you have robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed anywhere at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. The description is the only hint: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The likeliest reading is to order a cocktail at a bar or venue overlooking Ocean Beach and drink it while taking in the view. Do not chase this one early; it will probably pop during normal play around Vice Beach, and the method will be pinned down by the community within days of launch. Source for the status: the official description plus PowerPyx, which marks it unknown.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You can only steal it after unlocking the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Hack into the Banshee, drive forward through the window, and keep driving down the street; the pop is slightly delayed. It only unlocks from this specific blue Banshee, not any other car.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway — blow it with sticky bombs. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing enemies is not necessary. If you miss an item during the mission, wait for the robbery icon to respawn (it takes a while) and go back for the remaining valuables — the trophy is not missable and you do not need all 3 in one visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, select a character and scroll to Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club (filter for them on Map > Activities, the dumbbell icon; there are many across Vice City) or work out at home after the story. Always bring your partner (hold right on the D-pad, press Triangle to call them): while one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on Criminal Profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): whenever you do something that affects your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right of the screen. Actions span five profile tiers — Professional (stealthy objectives, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable, a permanent status from sustained excessive violence. You will very likely get this passively while working on other trophies and the 100% checklist — every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If you still need it at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car. Warning: at Psycho or Irredeemable, cops are more likely to shoot on sight, and Irredeemable never goes away, so do not push there deliberately.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed anywhere at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description ('Second time's the charm') suggests failing something once and succeeding on the second try, or returning to the payday loan store a second time. Treat any specific method you read elsewhere as unconfirmed until a guide pins it down; this is one of the five trophies no published guide had solved at launch. Source for the status: the official description plus PowerPyx, which marks it unknown.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM, and go alone. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed: sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside. If it is not there, drive away and come back until it is. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted — talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Method not yet confirmed anywhere at launch — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. The description ('Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by') points to knocking enemies down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, most likely a motorcycle kick. Try it on lone enemies at low speed, and do not trust any precise method you read until a guide confirms it. Source for the status: the official description plus PowerPyx, which marks it unknown.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts (fences). First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and payday loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total counts across all robberies; you never need $250,000 at once. It comes naturally while doing all robberies for the 100% checklist, and a single bank vault can pay up to $205,000 — but vaults only open after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types. The fastest way is the most expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. Shop counts across the state: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. This usually pops on its own while you gear up for other trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — there are 4 more story-related garages that do not count. They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app was installed on your phone; buy them through that app. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses); it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds one or more parking spots for registered vehicles. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray and then Register. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers, at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
